results.content:
Civiqs, a nonpartisan online polling firm that surveys presidential approval on a rolling basis, puts Trump’s current approval in Idaho at 49 percent, with 41 percent disapproving as of Thursday. That figure has fluctuated near that line in recent weeks. The Idaho Democratic Party cited the same Civiqs data in a statement released Aug. 19. [...] Wyoming, North Dakota and West Virginia are currently the only other states where Trump holds a positive approval rating above 50 percent.
